capabilities: play a pixel-art animation over the vault at startup
dismiss the splash with any key, a click, or Escape
show a still poster when reduced motion is preferred
toggle whether the animation plays on vault open via a command
read animation files from a fixed folder in the vault
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; submission is pending, so only manual installation works today. The animation files must be copied into each vault from the repository's media/ folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in startup animation or splash screen, so the vault simply opens with no decorative moment.
summary: Startup splash plugin that plays a short pixel-art animation over the vault once as Obsidian opens, then removes itself.
